name: AIChipQuick
description: A suggested prompt chip. Tapping one composes a message; it never executes. An optional special variant carries the gradient for an "All prompts" call to action.
intent: Offer a starting point so the user does not face an empty box.

props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: label
